create_activation_fn_module: create an ActivationFn module with a named activation function like gelu or swiglu for an FFN layer
run_gelu_activation: run the JIT-compiled gelu activation function on a PyTorch tensor using the tanh approximation formula
run_swiglu_activation: run the swiglu gated activation function by multiplying silu output with a gate tensor
run_geglu_activation: run the geglu gated activation function by multiplying gelu output with a gate tensor
list_available_activation_fns: list all available activation function names including relu, gelu, swiglu, geglu, and relu_squared
